backup.production_rule: S77 calendar contract. Expand only: one new table public.calendar_day_flags (RLS on, no grant to anon or authenticated, service_role only, admin_audit_row trigger), two new definer functions calendar_day_flag_set_v1 / calendar_day_flag_clear_v1 (search_path empty, authenticated only, owner/admin gate inside), and staff_home_v1(uuid) replaced from its LIVE body (md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) 7bfb1d05a9705d92cb063f2335a8c3c5, full pg_get_functiondef CR-stripped md5 58c1002541f968449c58e64af370292d, read 2026-10-08) with four additions: calendar[].block_reason, calendar[].block_label, top-level day_flags[], warnings[].key (the verifier_findings key; null for non-verifier warnings). Same signature and grants. No existing key changes. Production read 2026-10-08 holds one direct block (note 'DIR BD296460 confirmed'), one brownout block (Oct 14) and two active brownout notices, so the first live payload carries 'Direct booking BD296460' and brownout day flags. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

rollback.safe_until: always (the flag table is kept on purpose)

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Roll the Cascade Staff app back first, then apply supabase/rollbacks/20261008_calendar_day_flags.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: drops the two flag RPCs and restores the live staff_home_v1 body (prosrc md5 7bfb1d05a9705d92cb063f2335a8c3c5). calendar_day_flags and its rows are kept.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_additive_payload_keys
feature_flags.required_state: None. The new payload keys are ignored by the current Cascade Staff app and used by the calendar UI lane (L3), which also works when they are absent. The flag RPCs do nothing until the app calls them. Apply SQL first, then push the staff app.

compatibility.evidence: Readers: staff_home_v1 keeps every existing top-level and calendar key (pinned by pgTAP calendar_day_flags.sql); four keys are added. Writers: nothing writes calendar_day_flags except the two new RPCs. The 20261005 staff_home_v1 forward checks (no money or contact column named in the source, cleaner payload has no money/phone/e-mail shape) are re-run here. Rehearsal and pgTAP are owed: the workstation has no Docker and the rehearsal runs on the Alfred host over SSH (scripts/recovery/p6/migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh).
